name: Quality & Evaluation {OS}
tagline: Independent certification of what was built, before it ships.

commands.name: /quality
commands.does: Pin the build and the contracts, propose the certification scope

commands.name: /traceability
commands.does: Bidirectional requirement-to-evidence matrix with both gap lists

commands.name: /test-plan
commands.does: Risk-based test and evaluation plan, including what it excludes

commands.name: /qa
commands.does: Run functional and exploratory QA against the plan

commands.name: /regression
commands.does: Run the regression suite against the last certified build

commands.name: /contract-test
commands.does: Verify API, event and integration contracts

commands.name: /performance
commands.does: Test the non-functional requirements and report the spread

commands.name: /accessibility
commands.does: Test the build against the Design accessibility contracts

commands.name: /data-migration
commands.does: Verify migration correctness, invariants and reversibility

commands.name: /ai-eval
commands.does: Score AI behaviour over a stored dataset, versions recorded

commands.name: /defects
commands.does: Show or triage the defect ledger

commands.name: /verdict
commands.does: Issue the quality verdict with residual risk and uncovered surface

requires_human_approval_for: using production or real customer data in any test or evaluation
running a destructive or stateful test against a shared environment
issuing CONFORMS WITH KNOWN DEFECTS, which needs a named acceptance authority per defect
accepting a high residual risk into the verdict
narrowing an agreed test plan for time, cost or access reasons
publishing a defect that describes an exploitable weakness, which routes to Security {OS} first
